basedOn: Tafhim al-Qur'an by Sayyid Abul A'la Maududi (introduction)

sections.title: Where and when it was revealed
paragraphs: Ibn Abbas said it was the last complete surah of the Quran to be revealed (Muslim). Ibn 'Umar said it came during the Farewell Pilgrimage, at Mina. After it, the Prophet ﷺ gave his famous farewell sermon. He passed away about three months later.

sections.title: What it is about
paragraphs: Allah told His Messenger ﷺ: when Islam has won and people enter it in large groups, your mission is complete. So praise Allah and ask for His forgiveness.

Maududi points out the difference between a prophet and a worldly leader. In just 23 years, the Prophet ﷺ changed a whole nation. A worldly leader would celebrate such success. Instead, he was told to praise Allah and ask forgiveness, and he did, with humility.

sections.title: A sign of his passing
paragraphs: When it was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ said: "My death has been announced to me", and he passed away that year (Ahmad).

'Umar once asked the senior Companions about this surah. Some said it tells us to praise Allah when He gives victory. Young Ibn Abbas said: "It tells the Messenger ﷺ that his life is coming to an end." 'Umar said: "I know nothing about it except what you said." (Al-Bukhari)
"The victory" here means the conquest of Makkah, and scholars agree on this. Many Arab tribes were waiting to see what would happen. They said: "If he wins over his own people, he is a true prophet."
After Makkah was conquered, people came to the Prophet ﷺ in large groups to accept Islam. Within two years, the whole Arabian peninsula was full of faith (Al-Bukhari).
So glorify your Lord with praise, and ask Him for forgiveness. He always accepts those who turn back to Him.

'A'ishah said that near the end of his life, the Prophet ﷺ often said in his bowing and prostration: "Subhanakallahumma rabbana wa bihamdika, allahummaghfir li" (Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to You. O Allah, forgive me). He was putting this surah into practice. (Al-Bukhari, Muslim)

sections.title: Di mana dan kapan surah ini turun
paragraphs: Ibnu Abbas berkata bahwa ini adalah surah lengkap terakhir dari Al-Qur'an yang turun (HR. Muslim). Ibnu Umar berkata surah ini turun saat Haji Wada', di Mina. Setelah itu, Nabi ﷺ menyampaikan khutbah perpisahan yang terkenal. Beliau wafat sekitar tiga bulan kemudian.

sections.title: Isi surah ini
paragraphs: Allah memberitahu Rasul-Nya ﷺ: ketika Islam telah menang dan manusia masuk ke dalamnya dengan berbondong-bondong, maka tugasmu telah selesai. Maka bertasbihlah memuji Allah dan mohonlah ampunan-Nya.

Maududi menunjukkan perbedaan antara seorang nabi dan pemimpin dunia. Hanya dalam 23 tahun, Nabi ﷺ mengubah seluruh bangsa. Pemimpin dunia akan merayakan keberhasilan seperti itu. Tetapi beliau justru diperintahkan untuk memuji Allah dan memohon ampun, dan beliau melakukannya dengan rendah hati.

sections.title: Tanda dekatnya wafat beliau
paragraphs: Ketika surah ini turun, Nabi ﷺ bersabda, "Telah diberitahukan kepadaku tentang kematianku", dan beliau wafat pada tahun itu (HR. Ahmad).

Umar pernah bertanya kepada para sahabat senior tentang surah ini. Sebagian berkata surah ini memerintahkan kita memuji Allah saat Dia memberi kemenangan. Ibnu Abbas yang masih muda berkata, "Surah ini memberitahu Rasulullah ﷺ bahwa ajal beliau sudah dekat." Umar berkata, "Aku tidak mengetahui tentangnya kecuali apa yang kamu katakan." (HR. Al-Bukhari)

"Kemenangan" di sini adalah penaklukan kota Makkah, dan para ulama sepakat tentang hal ini. Banyak suku Arab menunggu apa yang akan terjadi. Mereka berkata, "Jika dia menang atas kaumnya sendiri, berarti dia nabi yang benar."
Setelah Makkah ditaklukkan, manusia datang kepada Nabi ﷺ dengan berbondong-bondong untuk masuk Islam. Dalam dua tahun, seluruh jazirah Arab dipenuhi iman (HR. Al-Bukhari).
Maka bertasbihlah dengan memuji Tuhanmu, dan mohonlah ampunan kepada-Nya. Dia selalu menerima orang yang kembali kepada-Nya.

Aisyah berkata bahwa di akhir hidupnya, Nabi ﷺ sering mengucapkan dalam rukuk dan sujudnya: "Subhanakallahumma rabbana wa bihamdika, allahummaghfir li" (Maha Suci Engkau ya Allah, Tuhan kami, dan dengan memuji-Mu. Ya Allah, ampunilah aku). Beliau sedang mengamalkan surah ini. (HR. Al-Bukhari dan Muslim)
